name: Run at startup
plain: Lets the app start in the background after the phone reboots.
meaning: Lets apps resume tasks after reboot. Android 15 restricts launching certain foreground services from boot receivers.

android.note: Android 15 (API 35) blocks some foreground service types from boot receivers (for example mediaPlayback, camera, microphone, dataSync, mediaProjection, phoneCall).

ios.note: iOS apps do not run at boot; only push, location events or background tasks can wake them.

limits.headline: Can start itself in the background after your Android phone restarts
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when you restart the phone
can: Start up again after a reboot to restore alarms, syncs or reminders
Run light setup work once the phone is on
Be allowed at install without a prompt
cannot: Start some foreground services at boot; Android 15 blocks types like media, camera and microphone
Do this on iPhone, where apps do not run at boot
Show anything at boot without notifications allowed
limits.differs: Android lets apps start after boot. iPhone only wakes apps through push, location events or background tasks.

story.what_it_is: Lets an Android app start by itself after the phone restarts.
story.for_you: You restart your phone and your alarms, reminders and sync work again without you opening anything. It is a quiet convenience.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to bring back timers and background tasks after a reboot. It is also how unwanted apps stay running, so Android 15 blocks some types from starting this way.

use_cases.example: A calendar app resets all your reminders after a reboot.
A pill reminder app brings back tonight's alarms.
A home app reconnects to your hub and cameras at startup.
A step counter restarts its tracking after a reboot.
A chat app reconnects so messages arrive after a restart.
An ad SDK inside another app restarts its own background work after boot.
A game with a timed farm restores its timers.

story.android_note: Granted at install. Android 15 blocks some foreground service types from boot.
story.ios_note: iOS apps cannot start at boot. Only push, location events or tasks can wake them.

technical_bounds: Needs the user to unlock first for credential storage
